cues.en: Let us continue our journey on learning how to use Python and sympy as tools for understanding mathematics.
cues.zh: 繼續學習如何把 Python、SymPy，當成理解數學的工具。

cues.en: What we are going to do in this video is focus on expanding terms.
cues.zh: 這段影片聚焦展開項目，

cues.en: And I'll also show you a little bit more about how to work with the sympy toolbox, and how to see what variables and functions and modules are already loaded into python.
cues.zh: 也會多介紹一些 SymPy 用法，以及如何查看 Python 已載入哪些變數、函數、模組。

cues.en: So expanding terms means something like this: if we say eight times the quantity b plus c then you can apply eight each of these terms individually.
cues.zh: 展開像這樣：a 乘以括號裡的 b 加 c，可以把 a 分別乘進每一項，

cues.en: That's called the distributive property.
cues.zh: 這叫分配律，

cues.en: So this can be expanded into this expression: a times b plus a times c.
cues.zh: 能展開成 a 乘 b，加 a 乘 c。

cues.en: Another example of expanding terms looks like this.
cues.zh: 另一個展開例子，

cues.en: So if we say the quantity A plus B times the quantity C plus D, then this whole thing can be expanded
cues.zh: 括號 a 加 b，乘以括號 c 加 d，整個能展開，

cues.en: into eight times C plus eight times D plus B times C plus B times D.
cues.zh: 成 ac 加 ad 加 bc 加 bd。

cues.en: And of course these parentheses are necessary because they're grouping together for the multiplication.
cues.zh: 這些括號必要，因為表示乘法前的分組，

cues.en: These parentheses are not necessary.
cues.zh: 這些則不必要，

cues.en: I just put them in here for visual aesthetics basically, so you can drop the parentheses and expand these terms into these terms.
cues.zh: 只是視覺美觀，可以刪掉，把原本的項目展開成這些。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So when you have a really simple case like this, then you don't need a computer, you don't need Python
cues.zh: 這麼簡單的例子，不必靠電腦、Python，

cues.en: to tell you how to expand these terms. But as you move more into more sophisticated areas of mathematics
cues.zh: 告訴你怎麼展開。但進入更複雜的數學領域，

cues.en: then knowing how to expand terms can become really useful.
cues.zh: 知道如何展開，就很有用。

cues.en: So let's get started.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: I've already written the code here to import sympy and the display and math functions because we are definitely going to need them here.
cues.zh: 已經先寫好匯入 SymPy、display、Math 的程式，因為這裡一定用得到。

cues.en: So I'm going to start by writing two terms.
cues.zh: 先寫兩個項目，

cues.en: Let's call this term one equals four times x plus five, and then let's say term two equals x and then
cues.zh: 第一項是 4 乘以 x，再加 5，第二項是 x，

cues.en: basically what I want to do is print out a term one times term 2.
cues.zh: 基本上想印出第一項乘以第二項。

cues.en: Now you can probably already guess that this code is going to create an error.
cues.zh: 你應該猜得到會出錯，

cues.en: It is not going to run and that's because we haven't yet defined X.
cues.zh: 不能執行，因為還沒定義 x。

cues.en: So I want X to be a symbolic variable. Now, so far in this course, the way that I've taught you how to
cues.zh: 要把 x 建成符號變數。目前教過的，

cues.en: create symbolic variables is by typing X equals sym dot symbols and then in single quotes x.
cues.zh: 方式是 x=sym.symbols('x')。

cues.en: So this is fine of course there's nothing wrong with this syntax, but I want to introduce you to another way of importing or creating symbolic variables.
cues.zh: 這樣當然沒問題，但想再介紹另一種匯入，或建立符號變數的方式。

cues.en: So here I'm going to write from sym dot ABC ABC.
cues.zh: 寫 from sym.abc，abc，

cues.en: This has to be sympy from sympy dot ABC import x.
cues.zh: 這裡得是 sympy，from sympy.abc import x。

cues.en: So this is a pretty neat syntax here.
cues.zh: 這個語法很方便，

cues.en: Essentially we're importing from the method ABC in the sympy module the object X and now when I run this code, this is going to work.
cues.zh: 基本上從 SymPy 的 abc 匯入物件 x，再執行就可以。

cues.en: Now just be mindful that this only works for a single letter.
cues.zh: 但注意，只適用單一字母，

cues.en: So if I were to type X and how about qwerty.
cues.zh: 例如寫 x，再試 qwerty，

cues.en: Now this is not going to work.
cues.zh: 就不行，

cues.en: It says cannot import name qwerty from sympy dot ABC.
cues.zh: 說無法從 sympy.abc 匯入 qwerty。

cues.en: So if you want any arbitrary variable name, then you're going to have to use the method that I showed you before.
cues.zh: 任意名稱的變數，必須用之前的方式，

cues.en: So asdf... I think I had this qwerty didn't I?
cues.zh: 例如 asdf，我剛才是用 qwerty，對吧？

cues.en: So qwerty equals sym dot symbols qwerty.
cues.zh: qwerty=sym.symbols('qwerty')。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 這樣就好。

cues.en: Now I'm going to delete this because I'm not actually going to use that variable qwerty.
cues.zh: 實際不會用 qwerty，所以刪掉。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now I printed out.
cues.zh: 接著印出，

cues.en: Term one times term two and not literally just print it out.
cues.zh: 第一項乘以第二項，結果真的只是印出，

cues.en: What I wrote here.
cues.zh: 這裡寫的內容，

cues.en: So we didn't get any expansion of terms.
cues.zh: 沒有展開。

cues.en: So let's try print.
cues.zh: 再試 print，

cues.en: Now I'm going to use the function sym dot expand, and then the input will be the same thing.
cues.zh: 這次使用 sym.expand，輸入同樣的內容，

cues.en: So term one times term two and now we get four X squared plus five X, and that makes sense because the four goes here.
cues.zh: 第一項乘以第二項，得到 4x 平方加 5x。很合理，因為這個 4 進來，

cues.en: Times... sorry the X goes in here and makes us X squared.
cues.zh: 乘上，抱歉，是 x 乘進來，形成 x 平方，

cues.en: And then we get five X and now you know by this point in the course that I am not a big fan of this kind of printing. I don't think it really looks nice.
cues.zh: 再得到 5x。學到這裡，你知道我不太喜歡這種輸出，覺得不好看。

cues.en: The thing is if you are looking at this line of code you can read it and if you give this code or if
cues.zh: 你自己看這行程式讀得懂，如果把程式，

cues.en: you give this output to someone else who is really familiar with Python coding and sympy coding, then they will also be able to interpret it.
cues.zh: 或輸出給熟悉 Python、SymPy 的人，他們也能理解，

cues.en: But if you would show this to someone who is not really familiar with Python, then they might not know for example that this means squared.
cues.zh: 但不熟悉的人，可能不知道這裡代表平方。

cues.en: Furthermore, once you get into math notation, the asterisk is often used to indicate a procedure called convolution, which is not the same thing as multiplication.
cues.zh: 而且在數學記號裡，星號常用來表示卷積，那和乘法不一樣。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So for all of those reasons, it's nice to use nicer looking formatting.
cues.zh: 基於這些原因，最好使用漂亮的格式。

cues.en: So let's say print and then we want the math function.
cues.zh: 先寫 print，再用 Math，

cues.en: Math function and then sym dot latex.
cues.zh: Math 裡面放 sym.latex。

cues.en: Now this is basically all review except when I run this.
cues.zh: 基本上都是複習，但執行後，

cues.en: Now it no longer shows me this nice looking equation.
cues.zh: 卻不再顯示漂亮等式，

cues.en: Instead it says that this is some kind of object.
cues.zh: 而是說這是某種物件，

cues.en: It's a display dot math object.
cues.zh: display.Math 物件。

cues.en: So what is going on here?
cues.zh: 怎麼回事？

cues.en: Well, what's going on here is just that I use the print function instead of the display function and
cues.zh: 只是因為用了 print，而不是 display。

cues.en: the main reason why I showed you that is because if you ever carelessly -- it's you really easy mistake
cues.zh: 特別示範，是因為這種粗心錯誤，

cues.en: to make -- but if you ever by accident use print instead of display then you'll get this message here, which is just printing out what this thing is.
cues.zh: 很容易發生，不小心用 print 代替 display，就會看到這個訊息，只印出物件是什麼，

cues.en: So this is a math object.
cues.zh: 也就是 Math 物件。

cues.en: So if you see an message like this then you know what you've done wrong, or you haven't really done anything wrong here, but probably not what you hoped you would be doing.
cues.zh: 看到這種訊息，就知道哪裡不對。其實沒真正做錯，只是結果大概不符合期待。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now I'm going to add another term. Let's call this term three and this is going to be X minus seven.
cues.zh: 再加第三項，叫 term3，內容是 x 減 7。

cues.en: So now I want to show you the difference between multiplying the terms and expanding the multiplied terms.
cues.zh: 想示範，項目相乘，和把乘積展開，有什麼差別。

cues.en: So I am going to write out display and then math and then sym dot latex term one times term three.
cues.zh: 呼叫 display、Math、sym.latex，內容是第一項乘以第三項。

cues.en: And so that is essentially similar to what we printed out here.
cues.zh: 基本上和這裡印出的很像，

cues.en: So you can see that Python didn't actually expand the multiplication.
cues.zh: 可以看到，Python 沒把乘法展開，

cues.en: It just printed out the two terms in nicer looking mathematical notation.
cues.zh: 只是用漂亮數學記號，顯示這兩項。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now what I'm going to do is copy and paste, except now I'm going to add sym dot expand inside the
cues.zh: 複製貼上，但這次把 sym.expand 加進，

cues.en: latex code.
cues.zh: latex 裡面。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now here with sym dot expand, so I've multiply these two terms, put that into the sym dot expand
cues.zh: 現在先把兩項相乘，放進 sym.expand，

cues.en: function, and then I've put that into latex and I put that into math and I put that into display. Fwooof!
cues.zh: 再把結果送進 latex，再送進 Math，再送進 display。呼，

cues.en: That is really a lot of embedded functions.
cues.zh: 好多巢狀函數。

cues.en: If you're ever looking at code and you see a lot of embedded functions like this and you're having a
cues.zh: 如果看到程式有很多這種巢狀函數，

cues.en: hard time figuring out what's going on, then the normal way, the way that your brain probably wants you
cues.zh: 難以理解，大腦通常會想，

cues.en: to try and figure out what's happening in this line of code, is to start from here and say huh, display and then math... but this is the wrong way to do it. The better way to decode a line of code that has a
cues.zh: 從這裡開始，display，再 Math，但這不是好的方式。要解讀這種，

cues.en: lot of embedded features like this, is to start from the most deeply embedded piece of code.
cues.zh: 多層巢狀程式，應該從最內層開始。

cues.en: So you want to start by looking for what's in the most number of parentheses. And then you start working your way outwards from there.
cues.zh: 找被最多層括號包住的部分，再往外看。

cues.en: So first we have the multiplication in these two terms and then we expand then we convert to latex code and then we input that into math and so on.
cues.zh: 先是兩項相乘，再展開、轉 LaTeX，再送入 Math，依此類推。

cues.en: All right. But the point is I wanted to show you that you need this expand function.
cues.zh: 重點是，要使用 expand，

cues.en: Otherwise the printout is going to be the same as the literal input.
cues.zh: 不然顯示的就還是原本輸入的形式。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: The next thing I want to show you is expanding with two variables.
cues.zh: 接著示範含兩個變數的展開。

cues.en: So we already have variable X so let's create variable Y.
cues.zh: 已有 x，再建立 y，

cues.en: So I'll say from sympy dot abc import y.
cues.zh: from sympy.abc import y。

cues.en: So let's say our expression is X times two times Y squared minus five to the power of x divided by x.
cues.zh: 式子用 x 乘以 2y 平方，減 5 的 x 次方，再除以 x。

cues.en: So who knows what this equation means, but it's something that looks kind of interesting.
cues.zh: 不知道這個式子代表什麼，但看起來有趣。

cues.en: So let's display this using nice looking math notations, so sym dot latex expr. Here is what
cues.zh: 用漂亮記號顯示，sym.latex(expr)，這就是，

cues.en: this equation looks like.
cues.zh: 它的樣子。

cues.en: And now I'm going to run this again, expanding this, so sym dot expand.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，這次用 sym.expand 展開。

cues.zh: 主要是想示範，expand 也能處理多個變數，不限於單變數運算式，

cues.en: You can also use multiple variables in this case x and y and that's really no problem.
cues.zh: 這裡有 x、y，完全沒問題。

cues.en: So we've created quite a lot of variables here.
cues.zh: 目前建立了不少變數，

cues.en: Well OK maybe not a lot but we've created several variables here.
cues.zh: 好吧，也許不算多，但有好幾個。

cues.zh: 問題是，目前到底有哪些變數、函數和模組載入 Python？

cues.zh: 輸入 %whos，單獨放在一個儲存格執行，就能看到漂亮、實用的，

cues.zh: 清單，列出所有匯入 Python 的物件、變數等等。

cues.en: So you see some of these are variables like X and Y.
cues.zh: 有些是 x、y 這種變數，

cues.zh: 建立為符號變數。

cues.en: Some of these are variables that we created like term one term, term 2 and term three.
cues.zh: 有些是自己建的 term1、term2、term3，

cues.zh: 要建立這個函數，

cues.zh: 有 x、y 兩個變數，是 4 加 x，也就是括號 4 加 x，乘以括號，

cues.zh: 作為變數名稱。

cues.zh: 「當 x=0、y=0，則 f(x,y) 等於」，再接實際結果，先，
